noise_stream: SeedSequence([20261010, route_id, anchor_id, drift, sensor_seed, snr, station_pose0, 811]); paired mount and arm common thermal innovations
G3: exact same update schedule as D: explicit alias; not extra run
schedule: all arms traverse 0 -> recorded angle index2 -> recorded angle index4 -> 0. Nominal 25 deg/s; exact fixed-truth increments <=5 deg per 0.2s; settle 0.4s at each waypoint; no acceleration model. Range and s at recorded three RF poses only. B/C/D measure all3; G1/G2 use first1/2 full-RF packets. Same physical clock in all arms.
motion: fixed true XY; gyro/wheel observations include sensor-v2 original slip, bias, scale and wheelbase mismatch. Slip does NOT move physical truth. No head model or hardware claim.
prior: original A after-odom from matching Tnone sample >=30s, mount0 prior reused identically for mount45. No truth in estimator initialization.
R: original default FilterConfig, s_mismatch_std=.09; only thermal CIR variance set from original observer noise reference for this new noise arm; no fitted R/Q/gate/prior tuning
Sigma_MP: held-out route excluded, same anchor/mount; exclude calibration sites sharing XY with evaluation site; one residual vector per distinct XY; min8 sites else COV_NOT_VALIDATED. Centered sample covariance of [s0,s1,s2,range0,range1,range2] fullclean - LoSclean. Offline calibration only.
Sigma_thermal: 32 independent receiver-noise draws per fixed station, nominal SNR; centered covariance, not RMS2; repeats do not increase multipath site count
mixture_and_H_arms: BLOCKED until all intermediate-time prior/measurement cross-covariance is propagated and independently checked. Original psi-only mixture is not rebranded full-P6 mixture.
scope_limit: limited fixed-truth control; not full-route reintegration, not physical noisy actuation, not cross-geometry validation
failure: preserve last valid state and covariance failure, no jitter/clamp
